title: Hair, Eyes, Height - Haj, szem, magas
grammar: van + third-person possessive (haja, szeme); height and age; nem ... hanem

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what hair and eyes someone has, like Barna haja van and Kék szeme van.
I can say that someone is tall, short, young or elderly, like Anna magas és fiatal.
I can ask what hair is like and say that someone is not one thing but another, like Milyen a haja? and Nem idős, hanem fiatal.
